description: Semiconductor and AI compute supply chain risk intelligence. Returns live risk signals across chip fabrication, advanced packaging, memory, rare earth inputs, and logistics chokepoints. Use when evaluating procurement timing for GPU/ASIC orders, assessing TSMC/Samsung/ASML concentration risk, or monitoring fab capacity constraints. Surfaces 30–90 day lead signals — conditions that will affect delivery and pricing before they appear in spot markets. Returns risk score (0–100), active alerts by segment, recommended procurement actions, and AI narrative. Data: trade flow monitors, fab capacity reports, rare earth pricing, shipping indices. 6h cache.
name: compute.supply_chain
